title: 习近平对美国进行国事访问
title_en: Xi Jinping state visit to the United States
note: 9 月 24 日白宫会谈与国宴；贸易休战延期、稀土出口、关税是议题。以白宫与外交部通报为准。
note_en: White House summit and state dinner on Sep 24; the trade-truce extension, rare-earth exports and tariffs are on the table. Official readouts govern.

title: 美国中期选举
note: 国会两院与州级选举；结果影响财政、关税和监管预期。
note_en: Congress and state elections; the outcome shapes fiscal, tariff and regulatory expectations.

title: 中美贸易休战到期
note: 2025 年 11 月 10 日起为期一年的关税休战到期；美方 9 月提出延长 3–6 个月，是否延长以官方公告为准。
note_en: The one-year tariff truce that began on Nov 10, 2025 expires; Washington proposed a 3–6 month extension in September. Official announcements govern.

title: APEC 工商领导人峰会 · 深圳
note: 领导人非正式会议前的工商峰会。
note_en: The business summit ahead of the leaders' meeting.

title: APEC 领导人非正式会议 · 深圳
note: 2026 年 APEC 东道主为中国；关注中美及区域贸易表态。
note_en: China hosts APEC 2026; watch US–China and regional trade statements.

title: G20 峰会 · 迈阿密
note: 美国主办，多拉尔（Doral）；贸易、能源与地缘议题。
note_en: Hosted by the United States at Doral; trade, energy and geopolitics.
